paragraphs: Rabbi Chizkiyah, in Abaye's time, in Abaye's name: Chullin 111b, near the end; Shabbat 38b, 108b.

(a) These said in Chizkiyah's name: Rabbi Aleksa; R. Chanina Toratyeh; R. Chananyah; R. Yudan bar Chama; R. Yosi and R. Yonah—Jerusalem Kiddushin, chapter 1, halakhah 5; also chapter 1 of Challah and Maaser Sheni, chapter 2, halakhah 6. In the name of the house of R. Yannai: Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Kirah. R. Yitzchak Chakola; R. Shabbetai; Resh Lakish—Bava Kamma 9b, 22b, and beginning of chapter 4 of Terumot.

(b) In R. Chizkiyah's name, or R. Chizkiyah in their names: in the name of R. Abba bar Mammal—Jerusalem Pesachim, chapter 8, halakhah 2; and R. Abba bar Zemina. In the name of R. Avdimi of Chaifa—Bikkurim, last chapter. In the name of R. Abbahu—Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Ein Omdin, and Sanhedrin, chapter 4, halakhah 7. Tosafot, Eruvin 96a, has in the Pesikta: R. Chizkiyah in R. Abbahu's name. And R. Avin—Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Keitzad Mevarkhin. He said to Rav Adda bar Avimi. In the name of R. Acha—Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of chapter 1 of Shabbat. And R. Achi. In the name of R. Ila—Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of chapter 1 of Shabbat. In the name of R. Elazar—Shekalim, chapter 2. And Rav Bivi—Shekalim, chapter 2. In the name of R. Bini. And R. Dostai. “R. Zerikan said”—Jerusalem Berakhot, chapter 1, mishnah 1. And R. Chunah. In the name of R. Chunya of the house of Chavran. “R. Chanina bar Abbahu said.” R. Chanina bar Agol. In the name of R. Chisda—Shekalim, chapter 4, halakhah 7; and R. Chisda asked R. Chizkiyah. R. Tavyomi asked him. In the name of R. Yehudah ben Pazi—Jerusalem Talmud, end of chapter 2 of Shabbat. R. Yehudah Gerogeret taught. In the name of R. Yochanan—Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Ein Omdin and Mi SheMetu, mishnah 1. In the name of R. Yosi bar Chanina—Jerusalem Berakhot, chapter 8, halakhah 7, and Sheviit, chapter 3, halakhah 5. Rav Yosef—Jerusalem Kiddushin, chapter 1, halakhah 6. In the name of R. Yaakov bar Acha—HaGozel Kamma, halakhah 3; see the beginning of Ein Omdin and Berakhot, chapter 3, mishnah 1, in the Jerusalem Talmud. “They were sitting”—there, chapter 2, mishnah 5. R. Yitzchak ben Elazar, in his name. In the name of R. Yirmeyah—Jerusalem Talmud, Ein Omdin, mishnah 2. And R. Kohen. R. Mana said: “I heard R. Chizkiyah”—Demai, chapter 1, end of halakhah 3. In the name of R. Simon. And R. Uzziel bar Chunya of the house of Chavran. And R. Pinchas. In Rava's name—Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of HaArel. In Resh Lakish's name—Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Keitzad Mevarkhin. And R. Shovati.
